name: se.curity.identityserver.haapi.android.ui.widget.previewer.host.HaapiUIPreviewerScenarioListActivity
description: The Curity Identity Server HAAPI UI.Widget SDK's debug previewer opens this Activity to list sample sign-in scenarios that developers can inspect. It is used to preview the interface during development, not for normal sign-in.
disableEffect: Developers cannot open the debug scenario list; normal Curity sign-in remains available.
